components.note: 父 (father) — a father-word radical, as in 爷 grandpa; 爸 is dad.
巴 (bā) is a close sound clue for bà; 巴 also sounds out 吧 ba, 把 bǎ and 爸 bà.
刀 (knife, written 刂 on the right) — cutting, as in 分 divide, 刻 carve, 到 arrive.
七 (qī) is a close sound clue for qiē/qiè.
扌 (hand) — hand actions, as in 打 hit, 拿 take, 把 hold; 抱 is to hug or hold in the arms.
包 (bāo) is a close sound clue for bào; it also sounds out 跑 pǎo, 饱 bǎo and 炮 pào.
欠 (lack, yawn) — open mouth or something missing, as in 次 and 欢; 歉 is feeling short, hence sorry.
兼 (jiān) is a loose sound clue for qiàn; 兼 also sounds out 嫌 xián and 谦 qiān.
心 (heart) — feelings and thoughts, as in 想, 思, 急; 感 is to feel or be moved.
咸 (xián) is a loose sound clue for gǎn; 咸 also sounds out 喊 hǎn and 减 jiǎn.
只 (only; measure word) — two old characters merged: 隻 zhī "a single (bird), measure word" and 只 zhǐ "only".
凵 (open pit) — oldest form shows a foot stepping out of a pit or cave: to go out, come out.
寸 (hand, inch) — hands and measuring, as in 寻 seek, 导 lead, 射 shoot; 对 faces someone or matches a pair. 又 here only stands in for the left side of 對.
灬 (fire) — heat and burning, as in 热 hot, 照 shine, 黑 black; a dot is a small spot like a spark.
占 (zhàn) is a loose sound clue for diǎn; 占 also sounds out 站 zhàn and 粘 zhān.
宀 (roof) — houses and shelter, as in 家 home, 安 safe, 客 guest; settling down under a roof.
正 (zhèng, upright; the lower part is written 疋) is a loose sound clue for dìng; also in 证 zhèng and 政 zhèng.
而 (and, but) — oldest form is a beard (compare 须 xū, beard), later borrowed for the conjunction; 而 survives in 耐 nài.
且 (moreover) — an old picture of an offering stand or ancestral tablet. As a sound clue it gives 祖 zǔ, 组 zǔ, 租 zū and 助 zhù.
必 (bì) is a sound clue for 秘 mì, 密 mì and 蜜 mì: the same series, with only the initial changing.
页 (head) — heads and faces, as in 头 head, 顶 top, 题 title.
彡 (hair strokes) — hair or beard on the face, as in 影 shadow; together a beard, later "must" (必须).
心 (heart) — mind and feelings, as in 想, 思, 感: 意 is what one has in mind.
音 (yīn, sound) is a loose sound clue for yì; 意 itself gives 忆 yì and 亿 yì.
田 here replaces 囟 (skull) in the older form: head over heart
心 (heart) — thinking and feeling, as in 想, 意, 感: 思 is to think over, with head and heart.
钅 (metal, simplified 金) — metals, as in 钱 money, 铁 iron, 铜 copper; 错 first meant to inlay metal.
昔 (xī) is a loose sound clue for cuò; 昔 also sounds out 借 jiè, 措 cuò and 惜 xī.
电 (electric) — simplified from 電: 雨 rain over 申, a lightning bolt (申 originally pictured a flash).
讠 (speech) — words and language, as in 说, 请, 谢; 话 is speech.
舌 (shé, tongue) fits the meaning (speaking) and is a loose sound clue for huà; also in 活 huó.
⺮ (bamboo) — bamboo slips, once used for writing and lists, as in 等 wait, 笔 pen, 笑 laugh.
弟 (dì) gives the exact sound; 弟 also sounds out 梯 tī and 剃 tì.
大 (big) — a front-facing person with arms and legs spread wide: big. As radical, 大 is in 天 sky, 太 too much, 夫 man.
宀 (roof) — houses and shelter, as in 室 room, 安 safe, 字 character; 家 is home.
豕 (pig) — a pig under a roof: pigs were kept in the home, hence home and family.
高 (tall) — a drawing of a tall tower building. 高 also sounds out 糕 gāo (cake), 搞 gǎo and 稿 gǎo.
⺮ (bamboo) — bamboo slips arranged in an even row; 等 means "rank, equal" and then "wait".
寺 (sì) is only a loose sound clue for děng; 寺 also in 诗 shī and 持 chí.
氵 (water) — water and liquids, as in 河, 海, 汤; water means life: 活 is alive.
舌 (shé, tongue) is a loose sound clue for huó; also in 话 huà.
医 (doctor) — simplified from 醫, which had 酉 (medicinal wine, as in 酒) at the bottom; the box 匚 and arrow 矢 remain.
取 (qǔ, take) is the base; the loose sound clue also appears in 趣 qù and 娶 qǔ. The top 日 here is an old cap shape, not the sun.
之 (of, go) — oldest form is a foot leaving a starting line: "to go". Now it is a literary particle meaning "of" or "it".
亻 (person) — people, as in 你, 他, 们: 伙 is a companion.
火 (huǒ, fire) gives the exact sound; 火 also means fire.
讠 (speech) — words and language, as in 说, 请, 谢; counting aloud.
十 (ten) — counting up to ten: 计 is to count and reckon.
亻 (person) — people, as in 你, 他, 做; 任 is a duty a person bears.
壬 (rén) gives the same sound, different tone; also in 妊 rèn.
亻 (person) — people, as in 你, 他, 们; 何 was a person carrying a load (荷 hè).
可 (kě) is a close sound clue for hé; also in 河 hé, 歌 gē and 哥 gē.
彳 (step) — walking, as in 行, 往, 得.
艮 (gèn) is a close sound clue for hěn; 艮 also sounds out 跟 gēn, 根 gēn, 恨 hèn and 银 yín.
多 (many) — two 夕 stacked, repeated again and again: so "many, much, more".
口 (mouth) — speaking and asking, as in 吗, 呢, 问: 哪 is a question word.
那 (nà) gives the same syllable in a different tone; compare 那 "that" and 哪 "which".
禾 (grain) — crops, as in 秋 autumn, 租 rent, 和 and 秒 second; 种 is seed or to plant.
中 (zhōng) is a close sound clue for zhǒng/zhòng.
上 (above) — a mark above a line, the mirror of 下 below.
帝 (dì) is a sound clue for 蒂 dì (stem base) and 啼 tí; the old shape is possibly a flower calyx, uncertain.
女 (woman) — a person kneeling with arms crossed; as a radical it heads many female and family words: 妈, 好, 姐.
人 (person) — a side-view figure of a person walking. As a radical it appears as 亻 on the left: 你 他 们.
口 (mouth) — calling out; 夕 (evening) beside it: in the dark you cannot be seen, so you call your name.
宀 (roof) — houses and shelter, as in 家, 安, 室.
子 (child) — a child in a house: to bear and nurture; characters were later "born" from other characters.
讠 (speech) — words and language, as in 说, 请, 谢; knowing means being able to name.
只 (zhǐ) is a loose sound clue for shí; the part replaces 戠 in the traditional 識.
日 (sun) — time and day, as in 早 early, 时 time, 明 bright; 晚 is when the sun is late.
免 (miǎn) is a close sound clue for wǎn; it also sounds out 勉 miǎn and 挽 wǎn.
其 (its) — an old picture of a winnowing basket (箕 jī adds bamboo). Sound clue: 期 qī, 旗 qí, 棋 qí, 欺 qī, 基 jī.
